race.comment: BACK TO BONDI (2) likes to race on the speed, so the fact he was able to win over 1700m last time out is a positive sign for the drop back in trip here. No reason he can't go back-to-back. COSMIC WALTZ (5) has had a heart-breaking preparation with five seconds (and a third!) from six starts, so he's a bit hard to tip with confidence, but draws well and should again be around the mark. PURE MAC (1) showed the benefit of a couple of runs back when he returned to the winner's list last time out and while he's right up in the weights here, the claims helps and he's well drawn. DOUBLE THE FUN (4) missed out in a photo last time when dropping back to 1600m, so staying at that trip should elicit another good showing. DIRTY HABITS (9) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start when he was always well out of his ground over 1600m at this track, beaten 3.5 lengths into fifth. Likely improver with strong prospects.
